items.title: Pigeons Playing Ping Pong- Gator & Ben interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 8, 2024
items.q: The mention of Richie Hayward is made by the [INTERVIEWER], not the [INTERVIEWEE]. The [INTERVIEWEE] does not respond to this specific mention or provide any personal connection.

ctx.x: Were there drummers that you paid attention to? Inspired you?

At an early age it was definitely more of, you know, a product of what I was hearing with my parents obviously, a lot of like classic rock, you know, a lot of drummers like Keith Moon, John Bonham, the classics that you hear, but a lot of guys like you know Richie Hayward from Little Feat and, you know, a lot of guys that, you know, really held down © Fillius Jazz Archive -3-

that pocket for me, you know. The flashy side is great too and you know you have guys that crush on all aspects to it, but just a lot of it was just those guys, you know, there was just those really good strong backbeats. And initially it led to different styles and kind of me diving down different roads and different styles and that brought about a whole new interest to me, but you know that classic rock vibe kind of initially is what appealed to me and, you know.
